```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE fiscal_year = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    fiscal_year = 2027 
    AND fiscal_quarter = 1
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE channel = 'marketplace'
  AND placed_at >= '2025-01-01'
  AND placed_at < '2026-01-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.country,
    SUM(r.amount_eur) / SUM(o.gross_revenue_eur) AS refund_rate
FROM analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN analytics.fct_refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.placed_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY o.country
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    d.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS new_customers_gained
FROM 
    analytics.dim_customers c
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON c.signed_up_at::DATE = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND c.first_order_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    d.region
ORDER BY 
    new_customers_gained DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(amount_eur) AS total_refunded_eur
FROM 
    analytics.fct_refunds
WHERE 
    refunded_at >= '2026-01-01' 
    AND refunded_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    total_refunded_eur DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(line_count) AS average_items_per_order
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(fct_order_lines.net_amount_eur - fct_order_lines.unit_price_eur * fct_order_lines.quantity) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_orders ON fct_order_lines.order_id = fct_orders.order_id
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fct_orders.placed_at) = 2025
    AND fct_order_lines.unit_price_eur * fct_order_lines.quantity > 0;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    s.channel,
    COUNT(s.session_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(s.session_id)) OVER() AS share_of_sessions
FROM analytics.fct_sessions s
JOIN analytics.fct_orders o ON s.converted_order_id = o.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.placed_at) = 2025
GROUP BY s.channel
ORDER BY share_of_sessions DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(fct_orders.net_revenue_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(marketing_spend.amount_eur), 0) AS return_on_spend
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_sessions fs ON fct_orders.order_id = fs.converted_order_id
JOIN 
    raw.marketing_spend ON fs.session_id = raw.marketing_spend.spend_date
WHERE 
    raw.marketing_spend.channel = 'paid_search'
    AND analytics.dim_date.date_day >= '2025-01-01'
    AND analytics.dim_date.date_day < '2026-01-01'
    AND fct_orders.placed_at >= '2025-01-01'
    AND fct_orders.placed_at < '2026-01-01';
```

```sql

    o.country,

    analytics.fct_orders o
WHERE 
    o.placed_at >= '2026-03-01' 
    AND o.placed_at < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 
    o.country

    order_count DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.dim_customers
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
  AND email IN (
    SELECT email
    FROM analytics.dim_customers
    GROUP BY email

  );
```

```sql
SELECT 
    d.day_name AS day_of_week,
    SUM(f.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    COUNT(f.order_id) AS number_of_orders
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders f
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d 
    ON f.placed_at::DATE = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY 
    d.day_name
ORDER BY 
    d.day_name;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.product_name,
    SUM(ol.net_amount_eur) AS total_net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_orders f ON ol.order_id = f.order_id
WHERE 
    f.placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND f.placed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    p.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
SELECT 
```
```sql
    p.product_name,
    COUNT(*) AS view_count
FROM analytics.fct_sessions s
JOIN analytics.fct_orders f ON s.converted_order_id = f.order_id
JOIN analytics.dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY view_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS average_units_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM analytics.fct_orders o
    JOIN analytics.fct_order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.placed_at) = 2025
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) subquery;
```
